visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A stylish man with brown parted hair and wire-rimmed glasses gazes into the camera with a slight smile. The background is a blurred indoor setting with flowers. A split-screen reveals the same man in a plain black t-shirt with a grey towel wrapped around his hair, looking upwards in a bright, minimalist room. (2) The man in the black shirt sits in a brightly lit studio or clinic lounge, pointing his finger at the center of his forehead. He exhibits a focused expression while a wireless microphone is clipped to his neckline. The room features light wood furniture and a small green plant. (3) A close-up side profile of the man reveals a small black triangular tattoo behind his right ear. He is engaged in conversation with an off-screen person in a modern interior with clean white walls and soft overhead lighting. (4) In a clinical consultation room, a doctor's hand wearing clear plastic gloves uses a cotton swab to measure or point at the man's forehead. The man holds a handheld mirror, looking at his reflection while furrowing his eyebrows to demonstrate skin texture and movement. (5) The man lies flat on a white medical treatment bed with his head resting on a pillow. A nurse wearing a mask and gloves uses a white cotton pad to cleanse his forehead. The lighting is bright and clinical, emphasizing the clean environment. (6) A male doctor wearing a surgical mask and gloves uses a fine-tipped black marker to plot specific points on the man's forehead. The man's eyes are open and directed upwards, following instructions in a well-lit medical procedure room. (7) A high-definition close-up shows a medical needle entering the skin of the forehead. A yellow cartoon bird emoji is overlaid on the injection site to mask the puncture. The doctor's steady hands and the patient's calm facial expression are prominent. (8) The man sits on a grey fabric sofa, now without the head towel, wearing his glasses again. He gestures with both hands while speaking directly to the camera. The background shows a textured light-colored wall and soft ambient studio lighting. (9) A rapid montage follows: the man appears at a professional photoshoot with vibrant red-streaked hair, wearing a white shirt and stylish jewelry. He smiles brightly and poses for photographers in various settings with cinematic neon lighting and camera flashes.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, upbeat electronic pop music begins immediately with a synthesized bass rhythm and a high-frequency percussive beat. A male voice speaks with high energy and clarity, questioning a man's identity. (2) The acoustic texture shifts to a clean indoor environment. A female voice with a professional, friendly, and soft tone explains different medical brands, specifically US and Angel Botox. The BGM ducks in volume to act as a supportive layer. (3) A male voice with an authoritative yet gentle quality provides instructions. A percussive 'click' SFX marks the start of physical measurements. The BGM maintains a steady tempo of approximately 124 BPM. (4) Short, sharp SFX including 'ding' and 'pop' occur during the treatment demonstration. The sound of a pen marking on a surface is faintly audible. A soft inhalation sound is heard followed by a calm 'OK' from the doctor. (5) The male main character's voice returns, now in a more relaxed, conversational studio environment. He speaks with a positive valence, describing the speed of the results. The BGM swells slightly in volume during pauses. (6) A series of camera shutter SFX and synthetic 'cheer' sounds layer over the final montage. The male voice continues with a higher-pitched, excited tone as he discusses year-end parties, ending the track with a final rhythmic musical beat.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Problem Identification -> Consultation -> Action/Procedure -> Testimony -> Result Montage.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional endorsement for Kiji Clinic & Biomedic. It follows a man's journey of addressing forehead wrinkles through a Botox treatment, detailing the professional consultation, the quick procedure, and the final confident aesthetic result to encourage viewers to try the service before major social events.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of 'Kiji Clinic & Biomedic', showing the treatment process, logo placement, and a positive testimonial.
